title: Silly Swans x Bare Bones
description: This Texture Pack changes the Minecraft Chickens into Swans!
body:
**This texture pack replaces Chickens and turns them into Swans!﻿**

**-Changes Chicken items to Swan Items**

**-New Spawn Egg texture**

**-New Sounds for the Swan**

**-Custom Baby Cygnet Model**

**-This pack REQUIRES EMF, ETF + ESF**

**﻿OR OPTIFINE**

**IMPORTANT - The custom Baby texture only works on 1.21.3+**
